title: Entity Generator
text: Generate entities, 2 inputs, 4 outputs, {Entity type} sets the type of entity to generate; {Generation method} selects the method of entity generation, {Time source} selects the source of the intergeneration time, {Period} defines the period between the generation, {Intergeneration time action} sets the time between entity generations dt =, {Generate entity at simulation start} sets the generate an entity at the start, {Entity priority} sets the priority of the generated entity, {Entity type name} sets the name of the generated, {Data initial value} sets the initial value of anonymous entity data, {Attribute Name} defines the name of the generated entity attribute, {Attribute Initial Value} defines the generated entity attribute initial, {Event actions} sets the behavior of the entity on certain events, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Pending entity present in block, pe} sets the pending entities and {Average intergeneration time, w} sets the average time between generation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Generation method
params.values: Select the method of entity generation Time-based (default) | Event-based

params.values: Define the period between the generation of entities 1 (default) | scalar

params.values: Specify the priority of the generated entity 300 (default) | scalar
